title: Homeowners Insurance Holdings Across Multiple Homes
content:
A customer may hold Homeowners Insurance policies from Calloway Insurance Agency on any number of homes they own; there is no limit on the number of policies per customer. Each Calloway home, however, carries one policy from the agency at a time.

## The two limits side by side

| Counted by | Limit |
|---|---|
| Customer | None: any number of homes the customer owns may each be insured |
| Calloway home | One policy from the agency at a time |

## Points of judgement

**A customer who already has a HomeShield policy on one home asks about insuring a second Calloway home they own.** The count of policies the customer already holds places no limit on this; the limit that applies is counted per home.

**A customer owns three Calloway homes.** Each of the three may carry its own Homeowners Insurance policy from the agency, one policy per home, so the customer may hold three policies at once.

**The same home and a second policy.** A home that already carries a policy from the agency does not carry a second one at the same time, whichever customer holds the first.
